# Kirolos Ehab

- CTO of The Saudi Times (Semrush Authority Score grown from 8 to 40)
- Lead developer of Meat Station (Flutter apps for customers, drivers, restaurants and admins; Laravel back-end; POS)
- Looking for a long-term, stable role with a major Egyptian company (on-site or hybrid); open to remote projects
